title: Edit profile
one_line: Change name and avatar. Validation and error states matter more than the layout here.

anatomy.spec: Tap-to-change avatar preview, straddling the top edge, opens avatar-picker.
Input field (bible 5.25), 3-16 character validation live as the player types.
SAVE, go green, collar. Disabled until the name is valid and something changed.

states: Too short/long - inline error, danger hairline (bible 5.25)
data: Writes to the player profile - server-owned once T-A2 ships (createProfile).
do_not: Do not enable SAVE with an invalid or unchanged name.
Do not allow profanity/empty names through without validation.
acceptance: All five states in 'states' are reachable and captured.
SAVE is disabled exactly when it should be.
steps: 2. Build the card with the input field and live validation.
3. Wire the avatar preview to avatar-picker.
prompt:
Polish the Ludo NX Edit Profile popup.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md section 5.25, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

Standard NX Card popup: avatar preview straddling the top edge (tap opens the avatar picker), a name input field with live 3-16 character validation, and SAVE in a collar, disabled until the name is both valid and changed. Add the name-taken server-check error and a saving spinner state - both are usually skipped and both will happen.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
